items.title: How do the average error metrics compare?

source.label: Annual metric aggregation
caveats: 2019 uses 8,760 prepared local-hour positions; 2025 uses 8,651 source-qualified physical hours.
The released 2019 DC case and current 2025 AC case have different inputs, physics and diagnostic operators. This comparison does not isolate topology effects.
Physical meter equivalence across the named interfaces and years remains unverified. Values were recomputed from saved results; no new power-flow run was performed.
The seven interfaces overlap electrically. Pooled results are benchmark statistics, not statewide energy error.
Signed errors can cancel. Mean absolute interface bias is separately calculated.
Raw MAPE is sensitive to near-zero observed flow. The 100-MW threshold is a disclosed sensitivity and changes the included population.

metricDefinitions.label: Equal-interface mean
metricDefinitions.definition: Arithmetic mean of seven interface-level metrics; each interface has equal weight.

metricDefinitions.label: Pooled metric
metricDefinitions.definition: Recompute the metric over all seven interface-hour arrays. This differs from averaging RMSE, WAPE and quantiles.

metricDefinitions.label: Bias
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean predicted minus observed flow. Positive values denote numerical overprediction in the declared orientation.

metricDefinitions.label: WAPE
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of absolute errors divided by sum of absolute observed flows, expressed as a percentage.

metricDefinitions.label: Error standard deviation
metricDefinitions.definition: Population standard deviation of signed errors around their mean.

metricDefinitions.label: P95 absolute error
metricDefinitions.definition: 95th percentile of absolute hourly error. The equal-interface summary averages the seven individual percentiles; it is not a confidence bound.

metricDefinitions.label: MAPE sensitivity
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean hourly absolute percentage error, calculated both for nonzero observations and for observations whose absolute flow is at least 100 MW.

evidenceFlow.title: Independent source reconciliation
evidenceFlow.detail: Primary metrics match the saved source tables within 5.684341886080802e-14 in their stated units. Source fingerprints and the current model pointer were checked.

methods.code:
def metrics(predicted,observed):
    predicted=np.asarray(predicted,float).ravel()
    observed=np.asarray(observed,float).ravel()
    assert predicted.shape==observed.shape and len(predicted)>0
    assert np.isfinite(predicted).all() and np.isfinite(observed).all()
    error=predicted-observed;absolute=np.abs(error);obs_abs=np.abs(observed)
    denominator=float(obs_abs.mean());assert denominator>0
    mse=float(np.mean(error**2));bias=float(error.mean());sd=float(error.std(ddof=0))
    assert np.isclose(mse,bias*bias+sd*sd,rtol=1e-12,atol=1e-8)
    nonzero=obs_abs>0;guarded=obs_abs>=100
    symmetric=np.abs(predicted)+obs_abs
    smape=np.divide(200*absolute,symmetric,out=np.zeros_like(absolute),where=symmetric>0)
    result=dict(hours=len(error),bias_MW=bias,MAE_MW=float(absolute.mean()),
        MSE_MW2=mse,RMSE_MW=float(np.sqrt(mse)),error_SD_MW=sd,
        median_AE_MW=float(np.median(absolute)),
        p95_AE_MW=float(np.quantile(absolute,.95,method='linear')),
        WAPE_percent=float(100*absolute.sum()/obs_abs.sum()),
        nRMSE_percent=float(100*np.sqrt(mse)/denominator),
        normalized_bias_percent=float(100*bias/denominator),
        MAPE_nonzero_percent=float(100*np.mean(absolute[nonzero]/obs_abs[nonzero])),
        MAPE_abs_actual_ge100_percent=float(100*np.mean(absolute[guarded]/obs_abs[guarded])),
        sMAPE_percent=float(smape.mean()),
        MAPE_nonzero_hours=int(nonzero.sum()),
        MAPE_ge100_hours=int(guarded.sum()),
        MAPE_nonzero_coverage_percent=float(100*nonzero.mean()),
        MAPE_ge100_coverage_percent=float(100*guarded.mean()),
        observed_zero_hours=int((~nonzero).sum()),
        observed_abs_below100_hours=int((obs_abs<100).sum()),
        mean_abs_observed_MW=denominator)
    assert np.isclose(result['WAPE_percent'],100*result['MAE_MW']/denominator)
    return result
